Comments (English): [ My savior who came to save me, the dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I have a video of the dishwasher in operation. This is a review of a product I bought with my own money after deliberating for a very long time and comparing it with other products. :-). My reason for buying: 1. Washing dishes is a hassle. Actually, I never used to find washing dishes a hassle. Sometimes, the whole process of lathering up a sponge with hot water and scrubbing the dishes vigorously felt like a form of meditation. Especially in winter, the steam rising would sometimes lift my spirits. However, as work got busier, that process no longer felt enjoyable. Tasks piled up, I had no time to rest, and finding some leisure time became difficult. Just then, an acquaintance told me they had bought a dishwasher. I was envious. At the same time, I was curious if it was really worth buying! So, I went over to their house to take a look, and it was nice. Their house was narrow, so it was a different model than this one. It was the same 6-place setting model that starts with 'S'. (I think you all probably know it^^). After putting the babies to sleep, I slipped the baby bottles in, and the machine started washing automatically. The bubbling sound was so refreshing! I returned home swept up in the thought, "Wow, this is great. I feel like taking a nap," and several months passed like that. The cost was a burden, and I was planning to move anyway. With all these excuses, I told myself not to even dream of a dishwasher and just silently did the dishes. Then, I made a decision! To this product! The width fits my house perfectly, and the price is so reasonable! I decided to invest in my leisure time, haha. Pros: 1. It's convenient. - It is really, really convenient. It is so convenient that words can't even describe it. I finally understood what people meant when they said they should have bought one sooner. Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. Even if I prepare a meal on the weekend, I don't just eat whatever is available to reduce the amount of dishwashing; I end up putting together a proper meal. Even if I take out every single pretty dish and make a huge fuss, it doesn't feel like a burden because washing dishes is so easy. It put my mind at ease and allowed me to escape the pressure. 2. Dishwashing becomes a work of art. It looks cleaner than when I used to do it. My husband helps with the dishes, but I clean even better than him, who is a neat freak. Maybe it's because it runs on high heat, but I'm just so satisfied. When I see the new plates and the spotless pans, I feel like rubbing my face in them. 3. The sound is good. When draining the water, it sounds a bit like a washing machine, but other than that, it makes a "bubbling" sound like other products. It's the perfect white noise for a nap, so I'm just happy. 4. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. The design is beautiful and clean, so it really brightens up the overall atmosphere of the house. 6. It's intuitive. It's easy to use. It has touch buttons, but there is absolutely nothing difficult about it. You just turn it on, select Standard, and press Play, and that's it. Haha. The downside. There is exactly one downside, haha. Even when you buy a stopwatch, they usually provide batteries. But I bought this expensive dishwasher, and there wasn't a single detergent sample included. So I had to just stare at it endlessly until I could buy some detergent. Aside from that moment of disappointment, everything is great. I'm not sure if my post was helpful. I was really encouraged to buy this after seeing a post from someone who used this product while living alone and said how great it was. It gave me the courage to purchase, realizing that it wasn't a luxury but a truly essential item for others. I hope this helps with your purchase, and if it was, please give it a "Helpful" like. ^.^ Have a happy day today. ^^. This is a review after 4 months of use. Everyone, don't hesitate. This is seriously the best money I've ever spent. I spent a really long time thinking about it and comparing options before buying it, but I'll save you that time! You just need to buy this. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): Actually, I never used to find washing dishes a hassle.

This is a review of a product I bought with my own money after deliberating for a very long time and comparing it with other products. :-). My reason for buying: 1. Washing dishes is a hassle. Actually, I never used to find washing dishes a hassle. Sometimes, the whole process of lathering up a sponge with hot water and scrubbing the dishes vigorously felt like a form of meditation. Especially in winter, the steam rising would sometimes lift my spirits. However, as work got busier, that process no longer felt enjoyable. Tasks piled up, I had no time to rest, and finding some leisure time became difficult. Just then, an acquaintance told me they had bought a dishwasher. I was envious. At the same time, I was curious if it was really worth buying! So, I went over to their house to take a look, and it was nice. Their house was narrow, so it was a different model than this one. It was the same 6-place setting model that starts with 'S'. (I think you all probably know it^^). After putting the babies to sleep, I slipped the baby bottles in, and the machine started washing automatically. The bubbling sound was so refreshing! I returned home swept up in the thought, "Wow, this is great. I feel like taking a nap," and several months passed like that. The cost was a burden, and I was planning to move anyway. With all these excuses, I told myself not to even dream of a dishwasher and just silently did the dishes. Then, I made a decision! To this product! The width fits my house perfectly, and the price is so reasonable! I decided to invest in my leisure time, haha. Pros: 1. It's convenient. - It is really, really convenient. It is so convenient that words can't even describe it. I finally understood what people meant when they said they should have bought one sooner. Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. Even if I prepare a meal on the weekend, I don't just eat whatever is available to reduce the amount of dishwashing; I end up putting together a proper meal. Even if I take out every single pretty dish and make a huge fuss, it doesn't feel like a burden because washing dishes is so easy. It put my mind at ease and allowed me to escape the pressure. 2. Dishwashing becomes a work of art. It looks cleaner than when I used to do it. My husband helps with the dishes, but I clean even better than him, who is a neat freak. Maybe it's because it runs on high heat, but I'm just so satisfied. When I see the new plates and the spotless pans, I feel like rubbing my face in them. 3. The sound is good. When draining the water, it sounds a bit like a washing machine, but other than that, it makes a "bubbling" sound like other products. It's the perfect white noise for a nap, so I'm just happy. 4. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. The design is beautiful and clean, so it really brightens up the overall atmosphere of the house. 6. It's intuitive. It's easy to use. It has touch buttons, but there is absolutely nothing difficult about it. You just turn it on, select Standard, and press Play, and that's it. Haha. The downside. There is exactly one downside, haha. Even when you buy a stopwatch, they usually provide batteries. But I bought this expensive dishwasher, and there wasn't a single detergent sample included. So I had to just stare at it endlessly until I could buy some detergent. Aside from that moment of disappointment, everything is great. I'm not sure if my post was helpful. I was really encouraged to buy this after seeing a post from someone who used this product while living alone and said how great it was. It gave me the courage to purchase, realizing that it wasn't a luxury but a truly essential item for others. I hope this helps with your purchase, and if it was, please give it a "Helpful" like. ^.^ Have a happy day today. ^^. This is a review after 4 months of use. Everyone, don't hesitate. This is seriously the best money I've ever spent. I spent a really long time thinking about it and comparing options before buying it, but I'll save you that time! You just need to buy this. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

With all these excuses, I told myself not to even dream of a dishwasher and just silently did the dishes. Then, I made a decision! To this product! The width fits my house perfectly, and the price is so reasonable! I decided to invest in my leisure time, haha. Pros: 1. It's convenient. - It is really, really convenient. It is so convenient that words can't even describe it. I finally understood what people meant when they said they should have bought one sooner. Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. Even if I prepare a meal on the weekend, I don't just eat whatever is available to reduce the amount of dishwashing; I end up putting together a proper meal. Even if I take out every single pretty dish and make a huge fuss, it doesn't feel like a burden because washing dishes is so easy. It put my mind at ease and allowed me to escape the pressure. 2. Dishwashing becomes a work of art. It looks cleaner than when I used to do it. My husband helps with the dishes, but I clean even better than him, who is a neat freak. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. The design is beautiful and clean, so it really brightens up the overall atmosphere of the house. 6. It's intuitive. It's easy to use. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

It is so convenient that words can't even describe it. I finally understood what people meant when they said they should have bought one sooner. Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. Even if I prepare a meal on the weekend, I don't just eat whatever is available to reduce the amount of dishwashing; I end up putting together a proper meal. Even if I take out every single pretty dish and make a huge fuss, it doesn't feel like a burden because washing dishes is so easy. It put my mind at ease and allowed me to escape the pressure. 2. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. The design is beautiful and clean, so it really brightens up the overall atmosphere of the house. 6. It's intuitive. It's easy to use. I was really encouraged to buy this after seeing a post from someone who used this product while living alone and said how great it was. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

With all these excuses, I told myself not to even dream of a dishwasher and just silently did the dishes. Then, I made a decision! To this product! It is so convenient that words can't even describe it. I finally understood what people meant when they said they should have bought one sooner. Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. Even if I prepare a meal on the weekend, I don't just eat whatever is available to reduce the amount of dishwashing; I end up putting together a proper meal. Even if I take out every single pretty dish and make a huge fuss, it doesn't feel like a burden because washing dishes is so easy. It put my mind at ease and allowed me to escape the pressure. 2. Dishwashing becomes a work of art. It looks cleaner than when I used to do it. My husband helps with the dishes, but I clean even better than him, who is a neat freak. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. The design is beautiful and clean, so it really brightens up the overall atmosphere of the house. 6. It's intuitive. It's easy to use. I was really encouraged to buy this after seeing a post from someone who used this product while living alone and said how great it was. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

With all these excuses, I told myself not to even dream of a dishwasher and just silently did the dishes. Then, I made a decision! To this product! The width fits my house perfectly, and the price is so reasonable! I decided to invest in my leisure time, haha. Pros: 1. It's convenient. - It is really, really convenient. It is so convenient that words can't even describe it. I finally understood what people meant when they said they should have bought one sooner. Even if the dishes pile up at night, I just grin from ear to ear. Even if I prepare a meal on the weekend, I don't just eat whatever is available to reduce the amount of dishwashing; I end up putting together a proper meal. Even if I take out every single pretty dish and make a huge fuss, it doesn't feel like a burden because washing dishes is so easy. It put my mind at ease and allowed me to escape the pressure. 2. Dishwashing becomes a work of art. It looks cleaner than when I used to do it. My husband helps with the dishes, but I clean even better than him, who is a neat freak. Maybe it's because it runs on high heat, but I'm just so satisfied. When I see the new plates and the spotless pans, I feel like rubbing my face in them. 3. The sound is good. It dries well. These days, our dryer and sink are completely dry. That's because this thing does it all. The kitchen gets clean automatically, and it requires less effort. 5. It's pretty. The design is beautiful and clean, so it really brightens up the overall atmosphere of the house. 6. It's intuitive. It's easy to use. I was really encouraged to buy this after seeing a post from someone who used this product while living alone and said how great it was. It gave me the courage to purchase, realizing that it wasn't a luxury but a truly essential item for others. I hope this helps with your purchase, and if it was, please give it a "Helpful" like. ^.^ Have a happy day today. ^^. This is a review after 4 months of use. Everyone, don't hesitate. This is seriously the best money I've ever spent. I spent a really long time thinking about it and comparing options before buying it, but I'll save you that time! You just need to buy this. I'm still extremely satisfied to this day. My husband and I talk every day about how well we made this purchase. We just watch TV and relax while I do the dishes. I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): Although the dishwasher cleans some items well, there are a number of problems with the unit.
Comments (English): Although the dishwasher cleans some items well, there are a number of problems with the unit. It was very difficult to find a fitting that matched the hose connection in order to marry it with the faucet threading. Even after measuring and making sure to get a male/female combination, it took several purchases before a correct, sealing fitting was found. Next, the bottom rack is strange. The tines for the racks are positioned incredibly close across the ENTIRE rack except where the utensil basket nests.This means that ANYTHING other than thin plates, or bowls that can be angled at a leaning angle DO NOT FIT. A thick sided plastic serving bowl with insulated sides DOES NOT fit within the narrowly placed rack tines. A large pot or pan generally DOES NOT fit within the narrowly placed rack tines unless one is extremely careful to manipulate the tins around the pot/ pan edges and often, not at all. A tall pot WILL NOT fit on the upper rack to compensate, some pans will, but that action takes up space that is better used for cups and glasses. The utensil rack is also disappointing. While fairly large in size, the top slot openings are too small for most normal sized flatware. There is only one detergent cup, and it is tiny. Its made for detergent pacs. But I DO NOT use unnecessarily expensively priced detergent pacs, and do not plan to begin., So the loads often DO NOT end up as clean as they should. At delivery, which was NOT FREE, I told the delivery team WE would install the unit, they deboxed it IN TH E STREET and took the carton so if we had found a function error later, how would we return it? A disappoinment all around.

Sentence (English): Whatever you do, do not buy this dishwasher or any Samsung dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Waste of money ] || ---------------- || Whatever you do, do not buy this dishwasher or any Samsung dishwasher. This dishwasher unfortunately came with our new construction home. It was great until it wasn't. We started having problems with it a few months before it turned 3 years old. Samsung's repair company came out to diagnose the problem (Tekniton). The error did not display of course while the repair tech was in my kitchen. He ran a super quick test on it, said "well it's not showing an error code now", charged me & went on his way. Maybe 3 cycles later the error came back. There was a 90 day warranty on that visit, but I was so frustrated with his lack of even wanting to try to fix the problem that I tried using a different cycle & it worked. We then used that different cycle for a few months & no issues. Of course 5-10 days out of the 90 days the error came back while using the new cycle. I tried to set up an appointment with Samsung's repair company again. I missed their call. I returned the phone call no later than 10 minutes after receiving the voicemail. No answer. I tried calling over & over, but no answer. I finally get a call from them the following day (the rep I spoke with was incredibly rude) & schedule an appointment only to get off the phone with the rep & receive an email saying my repair ticket was closed. I then decided to find an independent repair person via Yelp instead. A few of the replies I received from repair people in my area said they wouldn't even touch a Samsung dishwasher because they're "known to be problematic" (news to me as this is my first Samsung dishwasher). I finally found a repair person who came out. He decided I needed a new drain pump. Of course that piece was backordered on every website that sold it & it was way more expensive vs. any other brand's same replacement part. Apparently that is also known in the repair world - that Samsung replacement parts are more expensive to replace (also news to me). We received the part & the repair person came out today to fix. It ran fine for him while he ran two different cycles & then as soon as he left & I put dishes in to test it, the error came back. I give up. We're not going to keep paying for parts & repair appointments for crap machine. I will buy a new one from a different brand. Save yourself a headache & look elsewhere!

He ran a super quick test on it, said 'well it's not showing an error code now', charged me & went on his way. Maybe 3 cycles later the error came back. There was a 90 day warranty on that visit, but I was so frustrated with his lack of even wanting to try to fix the problem that I tried using a different cycle & it worked. I tried to set up an appointment with Samsung's repair company again. I missed their call. I returned the phone call no later than 10 minutes after receiving the voicemail. No answer. I tried calling over & over, but no answer. I finally get a call from them the following day (the rep I spoke with was incredibly rude) & schedule an appointment only to get off the phone with the rep & receive an email saying my repair ticket was closed. I then decided to find an independent repair person via Yelp instead. A few of the replies I received from repair people in my area said they wouldn't even touch a Samsung dishwasher because they're 'known to be problematic' (news to me as this is my first Samsung dishwasher). I finally found a repair person who came out. He decided I needed a new drain pump. Of course that piece was backordered on every website that sold it & it was way more expensive vs. any other brand's same replacement part. Apparently that is also known in the repair world - that Samsung replacement parts are more expensive to replace (also news to me). We received the part & the repair person came out today to fix. It ran fine for him while he ran two different cycles & then as soon as he left & I put dishes in to test it, the error came back. I give up. We're not going to keep paying for parts & repair appointments for crap machine. I will buy a new one from a different brand. Save yourself a headache & look elsewhere!

Sentence (English): It works well.
Comments (English): [ Good performance, surprising design oversights ] || ---------------- || It works well. The integrated water softener is a wonderful feature in an area with hard water. The dishes come out very clean and the crystal dry works very well. However there are some surprising oversights and design flaws. 1. The lower rack. It is optimized to fit a massive number of plates. How often is that a use case in the average household? The downside of this is it handles odd shaped items poorly. The gaps in the grate are so wide that items such as bowls can protrude low enough to obscure the lower sprayer. The lower rack also cannot accommodate half baking sheets, a common item in my household. 2. If you make a mistake in selecting the cycle you want and then press start, changing cycles is a surprisingly annoying process. As far as I can tell, you must reboot the entire washer which takes about two minutes to complete. This is extremely annoying when I'm trying to finish the dishes and move on with my life. If I select a cycle, press start, but don't close the door, then there's no reason other than laziness of a software developer not to allow me to change the cycle without delay. 3. Crystal dry will not work with the speed 60 cycle. This is really irritating because, if it did, this would be the fastest path to clean dry dishes. Unfortunately crystal dry is only available on the super long cycles which take 2:40 or longer. Maybe this is a limitation of zeolite, but it is annoying nonetheless to be locked out of the fancy dry feature when using short cycles. 4. Sentence (English): Congratulations on the launch of the new LG Dios dishwasher with enhanced convenience and differentiation in built-in 14-person solid green, nature beige, and freestanding nature beige models.
Comments (English): Congratulations on the launch of the new LG Dios dishwasher with enhanced convenience and differentiation in built-in 14-person solid green, nature beige, and freestanding nature beige models. When I heard about the launch of the 12-person dishwasher, I thought it had a really large capacity, but the new model holds 110 dishes. It has an amazing storage capacity of 14 people, which makes you admire LG's technological prowess. Moreover, the range of installation types has been expanded so that you can choose the type of baseboard that suits your kitchen, so it is at the eye level of modern people who value interior design. It's perfect ^^ In my house, which has a high baseboard height, I think it would be enough to install it as a regular built-in baseboard, and in Yoshi's house, I think a free standing system that can be installed regardless of the height of the baseboard would be good. With True Steam and True Dry, it has the same cleaning power and drying power as before. The smart shelf + maximizes space utilization so that more dishes can be washed while maintaining the same amount of power, so it's perfect for our house with many family members. In particular, since I have a super premium built-in unit, it is equipped with a slide rail that is used in kitchen appliances. This is the best part. It is often difficult to move the shelf after putting a lot of dishes in it, but I am proud of this as the best feature because it helps me open and close the heavy shelf easily with a little force. As I work two jobs, I often use the dishwasher late at night, so it is easy to use even in dark environments. It is equipped with an internal light so that you can load dishes, so you can use it without worrying about time, and you can use the ThinQ app to adjust the brightness to suit you. That's it. Voice guidance that sets the guidance level in 3 levels in the ThinQ app. This function is also essential for husbands and parents who are relatively unfamiliar with using a dishwasher. It provides voice notifications for hygiene management such as starting and ending the basic course, sterilizing the bin, and replacement of filter consumables, so it encourages smarter use. A new 14-person LG dishwasher with a great function that reduces limescale in wash water and water stains with a water softener function! The more I look at it, the more I like it. The more I use it, the more I like it. Sentence (English): With True Steam and True Dry, it has the same cleaning power and drying power as before.
Comments (English): Congratulations on the launch of the new LG Dios dishwasher with enhanced convenience and differentiation in built-in 14-person solid green, nature beige, and freestanding nature beige models. When I heard about the launch of the 12-person dishwasher, I thought it had a really large capacity, but the new model holds 110 dishes. It has an amazing storage capacity of 14 people, which makes you admire LG's technological prowess. Moreover, the range of installation types has been expanded so that you can choose the type of baseboard that suits your kitchen, so it is at the eye level of modern people who value interior design. It's perfect ^^ In my house, which has a high baseboard height, I think it would be enough to install it as a regular built-in baseboard, and in Yoshi's house, I think a free standing system that can be installed regardless of the height of the baseboard would be good. With True Steam and True Dry, it has the same cleaning power and drying power as before. The smart shelf + maximizes space utilization so that more dishes can be washed while maintaining the same amount of power, so it's perfect for our house with many family members. In particular, since I have a super premium built-in unit, it is equipped with a slide rail that is used in kitchen appliances. This is the best part. It is often difficult to move the shelf after putting a lot of dishes in it, but I am proud of this as the best feature because it helps me open and close the heavy shelf easily with a little force. As I work two jobs, I often use the dishwasher late at night, so it is easy to use even in dark environments. It is equipped with an internal light so that you can load dishes, so you can use it without worrying about time, and you can use the ThinQ app to adjust the brightness to suit you. That's it. Voice guidance that sets the guidance level in 3 levels in the ThinQ app. This function is also essential for husbands and parents who are relatively unfamiliar with using a dishwasher. It provides voice notifications for hygiene management such as starting and ending the basic course, sterilizing the bin, and replacement of filter consumables, so it encourages smarter use. A new 14-person LG dishwasher with a great function that reduces limescale in wash water and water stains with a water softener function! The more I look at it, the more I like it. The more I use it, the more I like it. Comments (English): Congratulations on the launch of the new LG Dios dishwasher with enhanced convenience and differentiation in built-in 14-person solid green, nature beige, and freestanding nature beige models. When I heard about the launch of the 12-person dishwasher, I thought it had a really large capacity, but the new model holds 110 dishes. It has an amazing storage capacity of 14 people, which makes you admire LG's technological prowess. Moreover, the range of installation types has been expanded so that you can choose the type of baseboard that suits your kitchen, so it is at the eye level of modern people who value interior design. It's perfect ^^ In my house, which has a high baseboard height, I think it would be enough to install it as a regular built-in baseboard, and in Yoshi's house, I think a free standing system that can be installed regardless of the height of the baseboard would be good. With True Steam and True Dry, it has the same cleaning power and drying power as before. The smart shelf + maximizes space utilization so that more dishes can be washed while maintaining the same amount of power, so it's perfect for our house with many family members. In particular, since I have a super premium built-in unit, it is equipped with a slide rail that is used in kitchen appliances. This is the best part. It is often difficult to move the shelf after putting a lot of dishes in it, but I am proud of this as the best feature because it helps me open and close the heavy shelf easily with a little force. As I work two jobs, I often use the dishwasher late at night, so it is easy to use even in dark environments. It is equipped with an internal light so that you can load dishes, so you can use it without worrying about time, and you can use the ThinQ app to adjust the brightness to suit you. That's it. Voice guidance that sets the guidance level in 3 levels in the ThinQ app. This function is also essential for husbands and parents who are relatively unfamiliar with using a dishwasher. It provides voice notifications for hygiene management such as starting and ending the basic course, sterilizing the bin, and replacement of filter consumables, so it encourages smarter use. A new 14-person LG dishwasher with a great function that reduces limescale in wash water and water stains with a water softener function! The more I look at it, the more I like it. The more I use it, the more I like it. Sentence (English): This is a nice looking portable dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Proceed with caution ] || ---------------- || This is a nice looking portable dishwasher. It runs very quiet. However, it does not dry the dishes. If you run the machine and the door remains closed after the washing cycle, your dishes will be wet when you go to put them away. Really? I have never heard of such a thing. So I wash the dishes before bed and I wait for the cycle to be complete (90 minutes) and I then open the door When I wake up and go to remove the clean dishes in the morning my dishes are dry. Very strange. The regular cycle takes 90 minutes. The controls are located inside the washer which makes it difficult to see how much longer this machine has to run. I have only had the washer for one week. So I am unable to comment on the longevity of the machine. In addition, it can be a challenge to load the machine.

Comments (English): [ Highly recommended for 2-3 person households! ] || ---------------- || I am a working mom in my 30s living in Ansan. My husband works late frequently, and since he said too much time was being spent on dishwashing, we decided to purchase this, and I am extremely satisfied. Pros: Stylish Design: With various colors and panel options, it blends perfectly with kitchen interiors. Powerful Cleaning Power: High-temperature washing at 75 degrees and powerful water jets cleanly remove grease and burnt-on rice. Convenient to Use: Fast drying is possible with automatic water filling and door opening functions. Spacious Interior: It is wider than expected; it seems spacious enough for a family of four to use comfortably. Even though we are a family of three, it fits perfectly. Price: It is cheaper than other brands. Cons: You have to drill holes for installation, and the installation fee seems a bit expensive. As mentioned in other reviews, if you are not the owner, you cannot drill the holes and must use a drip tray, but that seems too inconvenient to use. Sentence (English): This new dishwasher was purchased on January 29th, 2024 from our local bestbuy and is an upgrade from our previous LG washer.
Comments (English): [ Top Gun Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This new dishwasher was purchased on January 29th, 2024 from our local Best Buy and is an upgrade from our previous LG washer. The installation was flawless which is a key factor for ensuring proper operation and long-term reliability. Machine is extremely quiet, efficient, and the dishes including those made of plastic are thoroughly clean and dry using the AutoSense and Normal DryBoost setting in combination with the dishwasher's heated coil. I have yet to use any dry enhancer liquid to achieve an adequate level of drying which lowers its cost of ownership - would recommend Cascade Platinum Plus for best cleaning performance and avoiding long-term detergent build-up both inside the tub and on the rubber seals. Best of all, no more mold found inside the dishwasher due to the MicroBan coating of interior components, in combination with the stainless steel tub, something we always had to deal with in the past with our old LG washer and created a health hazard. Fingerprints and smudges hide well within reason due to its stainless steel coating. Florida's humid weather also contributed to the dishwasher's problem. The exterior is easy to clean with a damp microfiber towel - be sure to refrain from using harsh chemicals to protect the stainless steel coating. Try to clean out the filter inside the but at least once per week and you'll be fine. The dishwasher runs quiet and long-term reliability remains to be seen, but after a few months of operation we have no issues to report. Have not tried all the dishwasher's features at this point so can't comment on those but so far we're pleased with the performance and price point.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher as far as we can tell is ok.

They were rude, abrupt, just walked in and IMMEDIATELY said NOPE, WE CAN'T DO THAT. We are both disabled and it has taken over a week to install little bit by little bit and we still are NOT done. This has been too much stress perpetuated by Home Depot and or its contractors not disclosing they won't install if not directly next to the sink. This has been a very disappointing experience.

Everything comes out crystal clear and spotless. The 3rd row at the top for rentals and serving pieces means so much more free space below. As a result? We don't need to run it every day, which is better for the unit, the environment, and my electric bill. Buy it, you won't regret it.

Comments (English): [ Criminally (as in fraudulently) bad service- ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was good until it wasn't. Purchased in December 2020 from Best Buy and bought additional 4 year warranty direct from Bosch. It is very quiet and cleans reasonably well. However earlier this month is failed with error code e:07. Called Bosch service, they promised call back within 3 days to schedule a service. That seems like a very slow turnaround when your appliance isn't working! Even worse, the promised call didn't come. I had to call several times. Eventually (on day 6) I got a call from a scheduler. The first appointment they offered me was three weeks later! I protested and they “found” one sooner - still a 10 day wait. That day came, the tech took one look and said they had not ordered the parts they should have given they knew the error code. He called to take care of that and schedule to return - one week later. He came back after that one week and made those repairs - a design fault by the way, in which the crystal dry heater melts a hole in the main water pipe in the dishwasher tub. The replacement pipe had an extra plastic heat shield to supposedly prevent this. He also had to replace the crystal dry unit since the hole in the pipe had been spraying too much water in there. 10 minutes after he leaves, we try running a wash cycle and get e15 water tap error and the machine doesn't work at all. Had the tech's cell number he had called from before arrival. Called hi. And left a message. He did call back but basically to say he had now moved on as we would have to go back through the whole Bosch service call process again to book another appointment. So made that call (again). Didn't get a call back from the scheduler for another 3 days. Then to be told it would be another 21 days before we get a return visit! This is ridiculous: we paid $1500 for a “top brand” product and more than $300 for the additional warranty service contract. If they get it working at the next appointment, that will have been six weeks without a working dishwasher! At this time I cannot recommend Bosch (not just this dishwasher) to anyone. Their terrible and slow service does not life up to what you would expect from this expensive brand. Unless they suddenly wake up and remedy this situation with a sense of urgency and honor, I will not be buying any Bosch product again.

Sentence (English): We've run our new 500 series 3 times now and it seems to clean well, so that's most important.
Comments (English): [ Boche 500 series is an OK DW ] || ---------------- || We've run our new 500 series 3 times now and it seems to clean well, so that's most important. But some functionality is really ridiculous. Such as the utensil basket. I noticed in the store but thought maybe someone stole the real one and there was a fake, tiny basket inside the machine, just for show. Nope! The expensive machine actually comes with a tiny utensil basket that a family of 4 fills from one meal. Why would Boshe think this is what people want? I'm so thankful I snagged our old, larger, normal size basket before the old machine was taken away. While you could technically use the top third shelf to add utensils, no one wants to spend the time to align them so perfectly in the tiny slots so they'd actually get clean. Also, we like to keep the door cracked to minimize possible mold accumulation but the door is built so that the only two options are to be shut tightly or gaping open about 4". It's very inconvenient and sticks out way too far in our kitchen. Also, the control panel is supposedly "touch" responsive, but it's NOT very touch responsive so you sometimes have to push harder, and there is often a long 4-5-6 second delay until anything happens so by then you push it a few more times which ends up taking a few minutes to just turn the machine on because you have to "touch" the buttons so many times. It should take 3 seconds to touch 2 buttons to start the machine. This drives us crazy. Not sure if we got a bad control panel or if this is common but it's too inconvenient to return the machine so we are trying to live with the annoying touch panel. We wouldn't buy again based on these inconveniences. Our 14 year old machine was more user friendly but stopped cleaning, unfortunately.

Sentence (English): I decided to buy this model of BOSH dishwasher mainly because we wanted an energy-saving drying system that would not involve opening the door at the end of the cycle.
Comments (English): [ The best drying and quiet operation ] || ---------------- || I decided to buy this model of BOSH dishwasher mainly because we wanted an energy-saving drying system that would not involve opening the door at the end of the cycle. Choosing this model turned out to be a bull's eye. Drying is very effective, because even plastic containers are dry. The dishwasher is located in a kitchenette connected to the living room, so it was important for us to have a quiet program. In this model, we can turn on the night program, but I do not feel the need to use it, because the regular ECO cycle is quiet enough. It is also worth paying attention to the high energy class of the equipment, the steel bottom, the possibility of adjusting the upper basket, the capacious cutlery basket and small containers. To sum up, after a month of use, I recommend this model to everyone.
Comments (Original): [ Najlepsze suszenie i cicha praca ] || ---------------- || Zdecydowałam się na zakup tego modelu zmywarki BOSH przede wszystkim dlatego, że zależało nam na energooszczędnym systemie suszenia, który nie polegałby na uchylaniu drzwiczek na koniec cyklu. Wybór tego modelu okazał się strzałem w dziesiątkę. Suszenie jest bardzo efektywne, bo nawet pojemniki z tworzywa sztucznego są suche. Zmywarka stoi w aneksie kuchennym połączonym z salonem, dlatego istotne było dla nas, aby miała program cichej pracy. W tym modelu możemy włączyć program nocny, jednak nie czuję potrzeby korzystania z niego, ponieważ zwykły cykl ECO jest wystarczająco cichy. Warto też zwrócić uwagę na wysoką klasę energetyczną sprzętu, stalowe dno, możliwość regulacji górnego kosza, pojemny kosza sztućce i niewielkie pojemniki.Podsumowując po miesiącu użytkowania polecam ten model każdemu.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher was fitted by Miele and we were really pleased with the engineer who was very efficient.
Comments (English): [ New technology but overall a good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher was fitted by Miele and we were really pleased with the engineer who was very efficient. The model we chose gave us options on the Miele auto dos or our own dishwasher tablets. At first we found the machine slightly more technical than we were expecting but after a few “goes” we soon became more confident about different functions. We didn't expect the door to open on a lever before the end of the drying cycle (which is normal) and were concerned about having to gently fully open the door to released this when all lights had gone out for the end of the programme. Soon we realised that this wasn't going to break the lever and it automatically goes back into the dishwasher. I tend to use the auto dos or power wash cycles. The auto dos takes 3 hours but is very efficient re power etc and the power wash allows you to shorten the time cycle. I will endeavour to try other programmes but am still new to this technology. So far, all dishes and cutlery are beautifully clean. The machine prompts you to use salt and rinse aid which is helpful too. Sentence (English): This is my second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ My second dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is my second Bosch dishwasher. The advantage of purchasing the change. The same company installs the dishwasher front because the fittings and screw holes are in the same place. I see that the dishwasher door is better balanced in this model. The thing is that they do not close when the upper basket is loaded. A great solution is a separate drawer (basket) for cutlery. Thanks to this, we gain more space in the lower basket, where previously part of the space was occupied by a cutlery container. It is also nice to add soft rubber bands in the place where delicate glass is washed. For now, I'm using the intelligent program. In fact, this was one of the main reasons for purchasing this model. The only drawback I see is that the dishes are not completely dried. But this may be due to larger cavities in the dishes, which make it difficult to blow all the water out.
Comments (Original): [ Moja druga zmywarka ] || ---------------- || To moja druga zmywarka Bosch. Plusem zakupu zm. tej samem firmy jest montaż frontu zmywarki ponieważ okucia i otwory na wkręty znajdują się w tym samym miejscu. Widzę, że w tym modelu lepiej wyważone są drzwi zmywarki. Chodzi o to, że nie zamykają się w trakcie załadunku górnego kosza. Świetnym rozwiązaniem jest oddzielna szuflada (kosz) na sztućce. Dzięki temu zyskujemy więcej miejsca w dolnym koszu, gdzie wcześniej część miejsca zajmował pojemnik na sztućce. Fajne jest też dołożenie miękkich gumek w miejscu gdzie zmywane jest delikatne szkło. Jak na razie używam programu inteligentnego. Właściwie to był jeden z głównych powodów zakupu tego modelu. Jedyny mankament jaki widzę jest nie do końca osuszone naczynia. Ale to może być związane z większymi zagłębieniami w naczyniach, z których trudno jest wydmuchać całą wodę.

Sentence (English): Great dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher! Just wish it beeped differently! ] || ---------------- || Great dishwasher! Very quiet, cleans very reliably! One minor design suggestion for the next version of this. the beeping man, its not great! When the dishwasher finished, it beeps 5 times, waits some period of time, probably 30-90 seconds, and then does it again. and again. and again. Its like that microwave that doesnt want you to forget your food. I am perfectly happy to forget clean dishes! You can adjust the volume of the notification, and you can silence it, but I would love to have a setting of "single beep when its done" or something a lot more concise. I dont want to have to pause a movie to shut up a dishwasher! That said, its easy to silence the thing, and it really is an amazing little guy, especially for the price. Would buy again! Next version, change how it beeps please!

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for about 14 months.
Comments (English): [ Flawed Design requires expensive repair ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for about 14 months. It is now unusable because the diverter motor has failed. The washer fails mid-cycle and gives a 9-1 error code. A quick google shows this is a very common problem with this unit and has been happening since it was released. There are also other reviews on here that mention it. It usually happens right after the warranty expires which is my case as well. Adding insult to injury, Whirlpool/Kitchenaid charges over $350 for the part! What a racket… make a flawed, defective product and then gouge anyone that needs to get the part to repair it. Even worse still, I'm reading that the repaired units often break again in the same timeframe and then need to be repaired again. Clearly this is a known problem with the diverter motor and nothing is being done to address it. Probably some good profit in selling the parts so why make it right! Anyway, I'd avoid this unit if you can. I'm stuck with it for now and I will get it repaired I guess but if it breaks again I'll cut my losses and by a different brand. It looks great, but not worth the trouble, especially for the premium price.

Unfortunately, the only way I can think of to overcome this problem is to purchase smaller dinner plates to have full function of the bottom basket. Apart from this design flaw the machine washes and dries dishes very well.

Sentence (English): This is my first Bosch product.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher and worth the price. ] || ---------------- || This is my first Bosch product. I have long purchased mid-tier dishkwasher in the $500 range. This mid-tier products I would often have to run on the "heavy duty" cycle every time to get everything clean. And plastic would always be still wet at the end of the cycle. This isn't the case with the Bosch unit, I am very happy with it and it is very quiet. The thrid rack (the top silverware rack) annoyed me a bit at first - but on the side of it you can drop it a bit lower - this then allowed taller items (e.g. a coffee thermos lid, a spatula with a deeper angle, small measuring cups, etc). I now really like that feature, just had to adapt a bit. It is new, so I don't know the longetivity so time will tell.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher in January, it was installed and we ran it for the first time and were amazed.
Comments (English): [ Took a little getting used to ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher in January, it was installed and we ran it for the first time and were amazed. It worked perfectly and was very quiet compared to our (very) old dishwasher. Then we started having problems with an error code saying there was excessive suds in the machine. It would stop mid cycle, but when we opened the door there were absolutely no suds to be seen. After doing a little research I noted two things: excessive rinse aid can cause over sudsing, and having soft water requires an adjustment in the amount of detergent used. So the solution was to lower the rate of rinse aid usage (easily done using the control panel), and we can no longer use the expensive dishwasher "pods". We use liquid detergent and use less than a full dispenser. That's all it took. I also walked through this with LG Support. We are very happy with our new dishwasher.

It would stop mid cycle, but when we opened the door there were absolutely no suds to be seen.  After doing a little research I noted two things:  excessive rinse aid can cause over sudsing, and having soft water requires an adjustment in the amount of detergent used.  So the solution was to lower the rate of rinse aid usage (easily done using the control panel), and we can no longer use the expensive dishwasher 'pods'.  We use liquid detergent and use less than a full dispenser.  That's all it took.  I also walked through this with LG Support. We are very happy with our new dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Not our initial $ range, but wanted some specific stuff for our current life needs.
Comments (English): [ Best we've ever had - perfect for our needs ] || ---------------- || Not our initial $ range, but wanted some specific stuff for our current life needs. Changing family member ages and additions meant that our usage and needs had changed. This is BY FAR the best dishwasher we've ever purchased. It fits our needs perfectly. The sound is much quieter than all the previous dishwashers (some more expensive than this). Our initial thoughts of cheaping out because there is no difference was so wrong - this dishwasher is the best $ I've ever spent. It loads perfectly for us, unlike pictures, I certainly don't have chunks of food shoved into a dishwasher (e ) and I load it expecting complete drying and cleanliness. Everything comes out great. I like that the dishwasher uses very little water-wise, yet cleans so well. Who cares the time it takes, I'm off doing something else while it does the work (sometimes I just run it at night. why not cause in the morning, its totally clean and my kitchen is sparkling). Hubby had a harder time installing with this one, but it was a little different than the old ones so he just read the directions to locate the differences. very do-able even in our older kitchen. Read your directions (they are there for a reason) including the directions on the cycles and the loading (DUH! ). I'd recommend this to everyone and anyone. It is a delight for me to own it. Funny thing is I did a spreadsheet (yep, all the salespeople cringed at that) of the plus/minus of all models. thought I knew what I wanted. Then we went and looked at everything at SEVERAL different stores. When we opened this one, the quality of the door itself was heaven, the inside. like angels singing to us. the features, well you get the picture. It was everything we wanted, but never expected because we discounted it due to the price. I not only got it for a better than msrp price, but there was a sale that weekend that further reduced it. BINGO! SOLD!

Comments (English): [ Made a believer out of a skeptic. ] || ---------------- || I truly had my doubts about how big a difference a new dishwasher could make but no more. The install was easy and took me about 3 hours. About 45 minutes was spent trying to interpret the instructions for putting the insulation in at the front of the machine. I guess I got it right since it is so quiet. I don't write reviews of stuff very often, much less give 5 stars but this dishwasher is the real deal and worth every penny.

Sentence (English): Overall I'm very satisfied with the quality of the wash.
Comments (English): [ Amazing at washing, but not good at drying ] || ---------------- || Overall I'm very satisfied with the quality of the wash. It's definitely an improvement over my 15 year old Whirlpool. The KitchenAid gets around 95% of everything off my dishes. If it's a pan or crock with burnt on food it obviously won't cut it, and dried on egg or milk rings in glasses can still linger if they're heavy enough, but it's a vast improvement over needing to pre-rinse everything. Even peanut butter usually disappears without a trace. It's also blissfully quiet. My wife has opened it on more than one occasion to add dishes only to realize it was already running. I wouldn't call it completely silent, but if you're having a conversation or performing other tasks, you rarely notice it at all. My old unit had a loud hum and you could hear the water jets cycling from 30 feet away in another room. The only problem is the quality of the dry cycle. It just doesn't work. I've used heated dry and extended dry and everything is still wet inside after the cycle completes. I just open the door a couple inches and let it air dry overnight, but I shouldn't need to do that. And unfortunately this appears to be an issue with many modern dishwashers. They're sealed so well for efficiency that they just don't let the water vapor out effectively. Overall I still love the unit though.

Even peanut butter usually disappears without a trace. It's also blissfully quiet. My wife has opened it on more than one occasion to add dishes only to realize it was already running. I wouldn't call it completely silent, but if you're having a conversation or performing other tasks, you rarely notice it at all. My old unit had a loud hum and you could hear the water jets cycling from 30 feet away in another room. The only problem is the quality of the dry cycle. It just doesn't work. I've used heated dry and extended dry and everything is still wet inside after the cycle completes. I just open the door a couple inches and let it air dry overnight, but I shouldn't need to do that. And unfortunately this appears to be an issue with many modern dishwashers. They're sealed so well for efficiency that they just don't let the water vapor out effectively. Overall I still love the unit though.

Comments (English): [ Bad, unprofessional customer services from LG. ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in August of 2021. It was working great until March 2024, when it stopped working and gave an LE error code, which indicated motor trouble. Since the dishwasher was less than 10 years old and the motor was still under full warranty, I called LG's customer service center on 3/15/24 to make arrangements for repairs. I was told that a service repairman could be sent to my house to repair the dishwasher on 3/20/24., but first I had to agree to a credit card charge of $343.85. This seemed high to me since the cost of the motor's replacement was fully covered by warranty. I was told by LG's representative that this was their estimate, and that I would only be billed for the actual costs after the repairs had been made. When I talked to the LG service repairman after he had completed the repairs, about the final amount, he told me that he reported everything to LG and they would determine the final billing amount. I never received an itemized billing statement or explanation of the charges from LG. The only notification I have received of the final billing amount of #322.17 was on my March 2024 credit card statement. Even though this amount is slightly less than LG's estimate of $343.85, I still have no idea why it is so high since the cost of the motor that was replaced was covered by warranty. Had I known that just the labor costs alone to repair this dishwasher that is less than three years old would be more than one-half the cost to buy a new dishwasher of the same specifications, I would not of had this dishwasher repaired and probably would have bought another new dishwasher from another manufacturer. Perhaps the most upsetting thing to me about this experience is that I consider LG's repair services to be very unprofessional. I was given an estimate that seemed very, and when I asked why it was so high I was told that it included state sales taxes, which by the way, are not collected on services in California. After that, I never received an itemized billing of what I paid for the repairs. I am not sure, but I believe in California I am entitled to an itemized estimate of the repair cost before the work is performed and another itemized final invoice of the final repair cost amount.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher worked flawlessly for 2 years and 3 months.
Comments (English): [ Supposedly Bosch, but a bit crap. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher worked flawlessly for 2 years and 3 months. Purchased in July 2021, but connected in October 2021. In February 2024, an aria of beeping and a disco started on the panel. Everything was flashing along with the rhythmic sound of the dishwasher. The warranty no longer covered this circus, so I was forced to use an external service. What happened? Currently, it was enough to pour the water out of the bowl by tilting the dishwasher, but a few days ago the panel started flashing again, but the dishwasher still works. At least for now. Because if the problem persists, the bowl will probably need to be replaced because there is a high probability that it has become RUSTY and the AquaStop system turns on, which is why the panel goes crazy and, at some point, the dishwasher itself. Also for Bosch it's bad, very bad. When this one reaches the end of its life, I won't buy another one.
Comments (Original): [ Niby Bosch, a jednak trochę szajs. ] || ---------------- || Zmywarka działała bez zarzutu 2 lata i 3 miesiące. Zakupiona w lipcu 2021, ale podłączona w październiku 2021. W luty 2024 zaczęła się aria pikania i dyskoteka na panelu. Migało wszystko co tylko mogło wraz z rytmicznym dżwiękiem wydawanym przez zmywarkę. Gwarancja już nie obejmowała tego cyrku, więc zmuszona byłam do skorzystania z serwisu zewnętrznego. Co się podziało? Na chwilę obecną wystarczyło wylać wodę z misy, przechylając zmywarkę, jednak kilka dni temu panel znowu zaczął migać, jednak zmywarka działa. Przynajmniej póki co. Bo jeżeli problem się będzie powtarzał to prawdopodobnie misa będzie do wymiany bo jest duże prawdopodobieństwo, że ZARDZEWIAŁA i włącza się system AquaStop i dlatego panel wariuje i swego czasu sama zmywarka. Także jak na Boscha to słabo, bardzo słabo. Jak ta zakończy żywot drugiej nie kupię.

Sentence (English): I bought this unit to replace an older KitchenAid that suffered age-related failures.
Comments (English): [ The Quietest Dishwasher Ever! ] || ---------------- || I bought this unit to replace an older KitchenAid that suffered age-related failures. The bad: The unit arrived out of the box with defective threads for the water inlet valve. The problem: Kitchaid/Whirlpool designed and manufactured a cheap plastic part with plastic threads that connect to the inlet hose that is a metal piece. How the part passed QA is beyond comprehension. A further problem was with the wiring harness - it was missing a critical connector. Resolution: I submitted a warranty repair claim and the process could not have been better. The service contractor was easy to schedule and the parts I needed were shipped quickly via UPS no fuss. The service contractor was excellent - professional, responsive, and did quality repair work. The unit now works as expected. My previous KitchenAid unit was quiet, washed well, and heated and dried the dishes well, but not completely. Where it failed to dry the dishes was when coffee cups with concave impressions were left flat instead of leaning. so residual water remained on the cups after the drying cycle. This unit has the same performance - excellent cleaning, decent drying, just. one must not leave the coffee cups flat, rather leaning. Then all is fine. Now where this unit excels is how quiet it is. One cannot hear the unit running unless one's ear is next to the machine! When taking in to account the unit's price, the value is excellent. When taking into account the warranty repair experience, KitchenAid really took care of its customer. The only reason the rating is not 5 stars is because of the 1) cheap plastic part for the inlet valve and poor QA from the factory; and because it still doesn't dry better than the much older previous unit. Still, it is fine and I am very happy with the unit thus far. Because of the excellent warranty service experience, I give KitchenAid a big thumbs up. So would I recommend this unit? Yes, and would I recommend KitchenAid? Yes.

Sentence (English): I'm not 100% satisfied with this dishwasher, but I also don't completely hate it.
Comments (English): [ Was expecting better ] || ---------------- || I'm not 100% satisfied with this dishwasher, but I also don't completely hate it. We chose this washer after our 7 year old GE broke and there are features I wish this one had that the GE had. This Bosch just feels smaller overall inside and the racks themselves are flimsier. The tiny silverware basket is kind of a joke. This washer does not have an option to wash only the lower or upper rack on its own- you have to wash the entire washer in each run. Perhaps the remote start has an option to delay the start (I haven't set this up), but the washer itself doesn't offer this timer feature. The upper rack does not have space for tall/ regular sized cups due to the third flat rack above it. There are times when dishes aren't completely clean which is disappointing. I was expecting better results from this machine. This dishwasher is quiet though. I read reviews before buying and we run the dishwasher almost everyday. Overall, I wouldn't have chosen this washer if I had a chance to try before buying. I miss other features that it doesn't offer.

Sentence (English): Bought this on sale in December '23.
Comments (English): [ Love it but I think I got a Lemon. Re-order new 1 ] || ---------------- || Bought this on sale in December '23. It had everything I want such as the third rack, stainlesss steel tub, quieter than our last dishwasher and cleans the water more than once per cycle for better clean dishes. I also saw the reviews were good. Sooooo, just shy of 3 months later the dishwasher has been amazing. until it stopped working. It no longer pumped water out and shut off after about 5 min's into the wash cycle. It chimed that it was in distress and had a blinking light that blinked 9 times, then paused and blinked once more before serially repeating this sequence. It turns out the 2 were related as I looked up the 9 + 1 blinks on the internet equals dishwasher not draining. I did an above reasonable job trouble shooting. Checked the drain for clogs, in screwed the drain basin panel inside the dishwasher and cleaned that out (a little messy but nothing grotesquely large to cause a blockage). Pulled out the dishwasher, unplugged it, unhooked the drain hose and checked for kinks and clogs (nothing there). Then unhooked the drain house from the garbage disposal and checked for more clogs (nada). So re-hooked up everything and tried to start a new wash cycle. and yes. it stopped again about 5 min into the cycle. So the next steps in trouble shooting were to look at the motor or it's a mother board issue. Nope, not going there. Thank god for Costco's 90 day return policy which made it effortless (sort of) and was able to haul it to our local Costco to return ( dishwasher had to be unhooked again and loaded into our truck and then driven to Costco). Now I called Costco customer service and she was great and the 2yr concierge service is good but this would have taken a couple days to get a repair person out to look at the dishwasher and decide if it is repairable (then I imagined would they have parts in stock for the repair. supply chains are still an issue even this far out from the pandemic). I'm like, nope. I've got 5 kids and we cook at home most of the time so handwashing will be a nightmare and paper plates and plastic cups are only going to negate so much of the dishwashing because they don't yet make disposable cookware (disposable cookware is not a wish or a request just making a point). We need a dishwasher now and we are within the 90 day return to the store. So I look to re-order the same dishwasher from Costco ( ballsy? ) because we really really liked how well this dishwasher works and it's larger capacity and are sure this was just a lemon (it happens). Unfortunately Costco was going to take a week to deliver. So for $50 dollars more than I paid at Costco I found the same dishwasher on sale at a local "big box store" and installed the new, same, dishwasher and returned the broken one to Costco without issue. Love Costco's return policies. Their return thresholds have changed over the last 25 years I've been shopping with them but still the best return policies out there. Would I recommend this dishwasher for all the reasons I've already listed. yes. In spite of this hiccup it cleans large, family of 7, dish loads like a champ. If it hadn't broke down then I would have given it 5 stars. Because of Costco's amazing customer service and return policy I didn't give the dishwasher less than 3 stars especially when seeing how good all the reviews were. This must have been a lemon. Breaking in under 3 months screams lemon. I think I just got a lemon. We shall see.
